observations: Source page 2 is kept: the caption and the three lines match. The labels 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' and 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' are manga additions that tie each product to its user.
On the composed page, 02-2 shows Ananya behind an open laptop with one hand on the trackpad, so 'here' clearly means the laptop. The first reading's 'here has no referent' was a storyboard-only gap.
In 02-2 Ananya looks up and to the right, toward 02-3, where Meera holds the staff phone with a calendar icon. 'And our team...' reads as a natural continuation.
In 02-4 the clipped 'anany' label is an artefact of the storyboard face box. On the real page the short tail points to Ananya's open mouth and Meera smiles at her, so attribution is clear.
Minor: the 02-1 caption box covers the crown of Ananya's hair, but not her face. The 02-3 label covers Meera's lower legs and the chair, not her face, hands or phone.
Note for artwork, not a reading defect: in 02-2 the hand at her chin appears to be her left and the hand on the laptop her right, the reverse of the production ledger.
Unnumbered scan: the caption top-left, then the teal label top-right on the same row, then the middle row from left to right, then the bottom balloon.
In 02-3 the Meera balloon is at the top and the label at the bottom, with Meera between them, so the label reads as a tag after her line rather than as speech.
Composed page used: Ananya's upward glance in 02-2 and Meera facing out of 02-3 keep the middle row flowing left to right.

transitions.observation: A busy morning gives way to an office at sunset with a laptop form. The caption gives the time jump and links to Ananya's resolve to simplify.
The same office, sunset window and silver laptop. The camera pulls back from her typing hands to Ananya seated and thinking.
Ananya looks up and to the right toward Meera, who stands nearby with the staff phone. The same sunset window and desk laptop appear behind Meera.
A two-shot in the same office: Ananya seated with the open laptop on the left, Meera standing on the right still holding the phone. Their sides stay consistent.

From the evening office to a bright daytime reception desk, now with a monitor instead of registers. Ravi waving in at the door marks a later day and a new arrival without a caption, and that is enough.

readingReview.comparison: The first reading's order (caption, label; Ananya; Meera, label; Ananya) matches the intended arrays and the source. Its two concerns ('here' with no referent, the clipped label and short tail) are resolved by the art: the visible laptop and a clear mouth-to-tail link.
